steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0010, t0012, and t0013 dependencies are completed.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create task folder structure and initial files.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Review existing corpus papers (StyleTTS2, HiFi-GAN) for typical vocoder-from-scratch convergence epoch counts, per Key Question 2.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Search for a hifigan-shaped pretrained StyleTTS2 first-stage checkpoint (original authors, semidark/StyleTTS2, or elsewhere), per Key Question 1 — must happen before committing to the random-init decoder path.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0009 safeguard library, t0010 train_second_v10.py/joint_epoch fix/DP-aware loader, and t0013 inspect_checkpoint.py/audio_quality_check.py/infer_styletts2.py for reuse.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Design the decoder-init fix, corpus swap, training run, and mandatory audible-speech gate; resolve epoch-count and pretrained-checkpoint Key Questions before committing GPU time.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision LLM-T1-NC80 (2xH100) and deploy the idle watchdog before any long-running step, per task's disk-monitoring lesson from t0010's stuck teardown.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Fix ignore_modules, verify decoder init, train on the t0012 1531-clip corpus, run the audible-speech gate, and produce deliverables only if the gate passes.
steps.resume_sentinel: SSH to LLM-T1-NC80: tail -50 /home/azureuser/v11_train.log for the latest 'Epoch [N/50], Step [S/191]' line and a trailing DONE marker. Cross-check ~/kokoro-finetune/logs/v11/metrics.jsonl (tail -5, val_loss per completed epoch) and checkpoints.json (python3 -c json.load(...)['checkpoints'][-1] -- no jq on this VM) for latest epoch/val_loss/sha256. grep -c gate_fired metrics.jsonl (expect 0). At last check (2026-09-16T19:47Z): epoch 27/50 step 70/191, tmux v11train alive, 0 gate_fired, df -h / at 87% (unchanged), GPU util 11-18% both H100s ~73-74GB/96GB VRAM, loss trending flat/stable no NaNs. Training started 17:45:20Z; ~4.6 min/epoch observed epochs 1-26; joint_epoch phase starts at epoch 30 and may run slower (discriminator losses currently 0.0, not yet active). If DONE marker present and 50 epochs completed with 0 gate firings: proceed to Milestone C (audible-speech gate). If tmux alive and epoch count climbing: pause again with new resume-after. If tmux dead with no DONE marker and epoch stalled: job_dead, do not pause again, collect log tail, write intervention/.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy the remote machine and finalize cost tracking promptly, watching disk usage proactively.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Skipped: task scope is a well-defined diagnostic fix (decoder-init bug) plus corpus-expansion retrain with an explicit audible-speech gate; the Key Questions that call for alternative approaches (pretrained-checkpoint search, epoch-count sizing) are already covered by the research and planning steps.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, and metrics.json, reporting the gate outcome (pass or fail) honestly.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare speaker_sim/ttfb/rtf results against the ElevenLabs David baseline and published vocoder-convergence literature, consistent with t0010's precedent.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Formulate follow-up suggestions based on the gate outcome.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Final verification pass, session capture, mark task completed.
